subject: Evaluation consignment & MAP: access, usage limits, and close calendar
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimblehealth.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Evaluation consignment & MAP: access, usage limits, and close calendar

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the demo earlier. Per our discussion, I'm sharing a short mutual action plan and proposed consignment terms for the evaluation materials (prompt pack + test cases) so we can get the trial started this month. Attached: MAP_Redwood-NimbleHealth_v1.pdf (outline + milestone dates).

Summary / asks:
- Scope: NimbleHealth will receive a prompt-pack (limited to 45 prompts) and a test-case workbook for a 30-day evaluation on Redwood Hosted (non-production sandbox).
- Usage constraints: evaluation-only, no redistribution, retention for evaluation window + 30 days, no training on models, logs retained for audit only.
- Access: time-limited S3 presigned + password-protected artifacts; access for Olivia + procurement contact + up to 2 engineers.
- Timeline (proposed):
  * Day 0 (2027-02-16): MAP signed + assets delivered
  * Day 1–30: evaluation (engineering + quality checks)
  * Day 31–35: results review and decision call
  * Day 40: deletion/return confirmation or conversion to Sandbox license

Could you confirm the names for the two engineers who need access and whether procurement wants us to route the MAP through DocuSign? If procurement wants different IP/escrow language, please flag items in the attached MAP PDF — Marissa and Neha are on-copy for any redlines.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimblehealth.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimblehealth.ai>
Date: 2027-02-14T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation consignment & MAP: access, usage limits, and close calendar

Alex — thanks for the clear plan and the PDF. We like the proposed calendar. A couple of quick items from our side:

- Procurement wants any contract/consignment to be returned via DocuSign; they usually require a minimal purchase order if the trial includes restricted production-like data. For this PoC we do not plan to include PHI, but we'll confirm with security.
- Access list: please add our ML engineer Samir Patel (samir.patel@nimblehealth.ai) and QA lead Linh Tran (linh.tran@nimblehealth.ai).
- Usage constraint note: can Redwood confirm that logs will be retained for no more than 90 days and that audit logs (access, timestamps) will be exportable to us for compliance review?

Procurement — looping you in for the DocuSign step. Marissa / Neha — happy to review any redlines you send back.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Product Lead, Integrations | NimbleHealth

On Sun, Feb 14, 2027 at 09:12 AM Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Olivia — thanks again for the demo earlier...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimblehealth.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation consignment & MAP: access, usage limits, and close calendar

Thanks Olivia — quick read: we can accommodate the 90-day log retention and will provide an audit CSV export (access events + object manifests). Two small requests and an alternative delivery option below:

Redlines / clarifications (proposed):
- Retention and deletion: Redwood will retain raw access logs for 90 days; test artifacts will remain in the hosted evaluation workspace for the 30-day eval window and then be archived for 10 days for export, after which they will be destroyed unless you request transfer. We propose the Day 40 deletion confirmation step to be an explicit signed email from NimbleHealth.
- Exportability: we'll provide a single audit export (CSV) and a SHA256 manifest for the prompt-pack; we don't provide continuous log streaming for evals unless requested as a billable add-on.
- Usage covenant: 'Evaluation Use Only — no derivative training or redistribution; no embedding in customer-facing production SOWs without express written consent.'

Delivery option: we can either (A) upload artifacts to a passworded S3 presigned link (expires 30d) and add IAM constraints for the two engineers, or (B) provide a short-lived container in the Redwood sandbox with scoped credentials — option B prevents local downloads. If you want an escrow/neutral third-party holding the prompt-pack, we can discuss but that will add 3–4 business days.

I've attached the prompt pack and the current testcases workbook for your initial review (prompt-pack-v1.zip, testcases-v2.xlsx). Please treat those files as evaluation-only per the MAP.

Next steps I propose:
- Procurement confirms DocuSign preference and PO requirement (Olivia / Procurement)
- Alex to upload artifacts (we can do 2027-02-16 morning PST)
- NimbleHealth to run the 30-day evaluation, share the primary metric (F1 on redaction test + latency P95) in the Week 3 checkpoint

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Procurement Team <procurement@nimblehealth.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-16T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation consignment & MAP: access, usage limits, and close calendar

Hi Alex / Marissa — Procurement confirms we prefer DocuSign. We do not require a PO for this sandbox evaluation, but we need a short SOW + explicit data handling clauses included. Please send the DocuSign envelope and indicate whether the MAP is considered a binding addendum or a non-binding plan.

DocuSign contact: procurement@nimblehealth.ai. I'll expect the envelope link and an SOW doc we can attach.

Procurement Team
NimbleHealth
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nimblehealth.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@nimblehealth.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-18T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation consignment & MAP: access, usage limits, and close calendar

Thanks everyone — quick status update and agreed next steps.

Agreed items:
- DocuSign: we'll route the MAP + short SOW via DocuSign (non-binding operational MAP + SOW addendum). Envelope created: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ENVELOPE-8743321
- Artifact delivery: Redwood will upload prompt-pack-v1.zip and testcases-v2.xlsx to an S3 presigned link on 2027-02-16 (link will be emailed to the access list). Credentials will be scoped to Samir Patel and Linh Tran.
- Logs & retention: Redwood confirms audit/export CSV (90-day retention) and SHA256 manifest for delivered assets.
- Timeline: evaluation window 2027-02-16 to 2027-03-17. Week 3 checkpoint call requested (2027-03-08) to review F1 + latency metrics.

Next steps for Redwood (owner):
1) Send DocuSign envelope to procurement@nimblehealth.ai (Alex) — by EOD 2027-02-18
2) Upload artifacts and share secure link (Marissa) — scheduled 2027-02-16 morning PST (complete)
3) Confirm access list and enable audit export (Neha) — by 2027-02-17

Please reply if any of the above needs a different cadence. We'll treat the MAP as the operational plan for the evaluation and follow any procurement redlines if they request contract language changes.

Regards,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_Redwood-NimbleHealth_v1.pdf
